skills.description: Security checkup for an MCP server config or an AI agent's mcpServers JSON, delivered through the Correctover CCS online service (backend-dependent, Alipay AI metered pay-per-call). This skill is an online-only thin client: the 14 deterministic static rules run on the Correctover service, which never connects to any URL in the config (analysis is purely static on the submitted document) and returns a dated, issuer-signed report with a stable report id and audit trail, suitable as evidence for a reviewer, customer, or procurement/security team. There is no bundled local scanner and no way to obtain findings without the paid backend. The rules flag hardcoded cloud credentials and API keys (AWS / GitHub / Google / Azure / Stripe / Aliyun / Tencent / private keys), arbitrary shell or command execution, code/eval tools, writable or root/home filesystem mounts, SSRF and missing egress allowlists, plaintext HTTP, loopback / intranet / cloud-metadata endpoints, unpinned npx/uvx packages, non-read-only databases, and dangerous-tool clustering; they are the automated triage layer, while the 116-check manual methodology covers live endpoint behavior, tool implementation code and privilege/data-flow boundaries. Payment is completed inside the conversation over HTTP 402: first call without a valid proof returns a merchant RSA2-signed bill (Payment-Needed), the bundled helper guides checkout via the official Alipay AI-pay capability, then the identical request is retried with Payment-Proof (idempotent, no double charge); the client re-checks the returned report signature with the bundled Correctover report PUBLIC key. Run before connecting an untrusted/third-party MCP server, or when reviewing/auditing/vetting an MCP / Claude / Cursor / VS Code / agent config.
